summary: Applied three spec-review repairs for non-interactive setup main selection, non-interactive agent file target defaults, and existing config wizard default normalization.

items.title: Non-interactive multi-agent main selection is ambiguous
items.rationale: Defined first-listed family semantics for comma-separated --agent values and updated requirement, acceptance criteria, data flow, overview decision, and setup task acceptance.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R3 now states first-listed family is main/default; acceptance_criteria includes --agent claude,codex and --agent codex,claude.

items.title: Non-interactive instruction-file targets are undefined for multi-agent setup
items.rationale: Specified that non-interactive multi-agent setup generates both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md by default, while interactive setup still lets users choose targets.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R6 and acceptance_criteria now define interactive target selection and non-interactive both-file default.

items.title: Existing config setup defaults are not specified
items.rationale: Added R9 to require rerunning setup to normalize existing family aliases, concrete provider keys, and built-in useProfile names into wizard availability/main defaults.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R9 and acceptance_criteria now cover existing config setup default normalization.
